title: Punjab Congress Factionalism Erupts During Bhupesh Baghel Visit
summary: During a visit to Punjab, AICC General Secretary Bhupesh Baghel was confronted by supporters of former Chief Minister Channi at a party event. The incident occurred in Patti and Sangrur during the party's campaign events. Supporters of Channi shouted slogans in support of him while Baghel responded by stating that those who violate discipline will be expelled from the party.
summary_points: AICC General Secretary Bhupesh Baghel visited Punjab
Supporters of former Chief Minister Channi shouted slogans in support of him at a party event
The incident occurred in Patti and Sangrur during the party's campaign events
Baghel stated that those who violate discipline will be expelled from the party

summary_hi: AICC प्रभारी भूपेश बघेल के सामने ही चन्नी के सपोर्ट में नारेबाजी, भड़के पंजाब प्रभारी
summary_points_hi: AICC प्रभारी भूपेश बघेल पंजाब गए
चन्नी के समर्थकों ने चन्नी के लिए नारे लगाए
इस घटना पट्टी और संगरूर में हुई थी
बघेल ने कहा कि अनुशासनहीनता करने वालों को पार्टी से निकाल देंगे

framing_hi.right: राइट-लीनिंग आउटलेट्स पार्टी में गुटबाजी (फैक्शनलिज्म) को उजागर करते हैं, चन्नी समर्थकों द्वारा आयोजन पर व्यवधान करने की भूमिका को जोर देते हैं
